                      enableSystem

                      <AppBannerContextProvider>
                        <CommandProvider>
                          <FeaturePreviewContextProvider>
                            {getLayout(<Component {...pageProps} />)}
                            <StudioCommandMenu />
                            <GenerateSql />
                            <FeaturePreviewModal />
                          </FeaturePreviewContextProvider>
                          <SonnerToaster position="top-right" />
                          <MonacoThemeProvider />
                        </CommandProvider>
                      </AppBannerContextProvider>
                    </ThemeProvider>
                  </RouteValidationWrapper>
                </TooltipProvider>

                <PageTelemetry

              </ProfileProvider>

          </AuthProvider>
        </Hydrate>

    </ErrorBoundary>
  )
}
